2608.18836.title: Verifiable abstention makes AI leak diagnosis accountable in water distribution networks
2608.18836.paper_summary: Utilities lose a substantial share of treated water to leakage, yet rarely trust artificial-intelligence localizers to dispatch crews: guessing everywhere cannot justify excavation. The gap is accountability, not accuracy: no method proves when it should not act. Here we recast leak localization as decision-making under verifiable abstention. A physics-grounded executor agent falsifies hypotheses (leak, demand, sensor, valve) against a digital twin; an independent supervisor agent, with a large-language-model (LLM) auditor, checks evidence against a code-verifiable contract, then certifies a dispatch, requests evidence or abstains. Under field-grade noise, a 32% forced baseline becomes 96% decision precision on acted events. On an independently generated benchmark it acts on only 4 of 33 leaks, all correct. A 194-event register of audited real leak locations with twin-simulated pressures and flows yields five excavation dispatches, three correct, and 44% survey recovery at full district precision. Accountable abstention offers a defensible route to autonomous water-infrastructure operation.
2608.18836.paper_summary_zh: 公用事業部門因漏水而損失了大量處理過的水，但卻很少信任人工智慧定位器來派遣工作人員：隨便猜測無法證明挖掘的合理性。這裡的差距在於責任，而非準確性：沒有任何方法能證明何時不應該行動。在這裡，我們將漏水定位重新定義為在可驗證的放棄下的決策過程。一個基於物理的執行代理對假設（漏水、需求、傳感器、閥門）進行驗證，並與數位雙胞胎進行對比；一個獨立的監督代理，配備大型語言模型（LLM）審計員，檢查證據是否符合可代碼驗證的合約，然後認證派遣、請求證據或選擇放棄。在現場噪音的情況下，32%的強制基線變成了96%的行動事件決策精度。在一個獨立生成的基準上，它僅對33個漏水事件中的4個採取行動，且全都正確。對於經過審計的真實漏水位置的194事件登記，配合雙胞胎模擬的壓力和流量，產生了五次挖掘派遣，其中三次正確，並在全區精度下實現了44%的調查恢復。負責任的放棄提供了一條可辯護的路徑，以實現自主的水基礎設施運營。
